name: Elections
description: Nonpartisan election dates and voting rules in the United States: voter registration deadlines, early voting and mail ballot dates by state, what is on the ballot, poll closing times and when results are expected. Every date, deadline and ballot measure comes from the state election office, the county elections board or the official ballot text, and each story names the office it relies on. Stories carry no polls, predictions or endorsements. Each piece links to the November printable calendar and the related when-is page so voters can mark registration cutoffs, the last day to mail a ballot and Election Day itself.
